text: In 1973, an archive containing the manuscript of Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn's The Gulag Archipelago was seized, and its holder, Elizaveta Voronyanskaya, died by suicide. The book was published in Paris that December. In February 1974, Soviet authorities retaliated by arresting Solzhenitsyn, stripping him of his Soviet citizenship and sending him against his will to Frankfurt, West Germany. In Poland, the book was suppressed across the Soviet bloc and circulated in samizdat until 1989.
